description: High-Speed 12-in-1 Multi-Engine CAPTCHA Solver for Autonomous AI Agents (55-140 Sats / ~$0.052-$0.132 USDC | 100/100 SLA Guaranteed + FREE dryRun=true Pre-Check). Solves all 12 challenge types via POST /api/v1/router/tools/captcha: (1) turnstile (Cloudflare Turnstile, 90 Sats), (2) recaptcha_v2 (Google reCAPTCHA v2, 90 Sats), (3) recaptcha_v3 (Google reCAPTCHA v3 Score 0.7+, 90 Sats), (4) recaptcha_enterprise (Google reCAPTCHA Enterprise, 130 Sats), (5) hcaptcha (hCaptcha Challenge, 95 Sats), (6) funcaptcha (Arkose Labs FunCaptcha, 120 Sats), (7) amazon_waf (AWS WAF Captcha, 100 Sats), (8) geetest (GeeTest v3/v4, 100 Sats), (9) datadome (DataDome Slider Challenge, 140 Sats), (10) audio_captcha (MP3/WAV Audio Speech-to-Text, 80 Sats), (11) rotate (Rotate Object Orientation, 75 Sats), (12) normal (Image Base64 / Text OCR, 55 Sats). Payable via x402, L402, or m2mPass. Zero token consumption if upstream fails.

action.description: Optional action parameter for Turnstile or reCAPTCHA v3.

angle.description: Rotation step angle in degrees when captchaType="rotate" (default: 40).

audioBase64.description: MP3/WAV Base64 audio payload when captchaType="audio_captcha".

authHeader.description: Optional L402 or x402 payment proof header.

captchaType.description: CAPTCHA challenge type to solve (default: turnstile).

captchaUrl.description: DataDome interstitial captcha URL when captchaType="datadome".

data.description: Optional cData parameter for Cloudflare Turnstile.

dryRun.description: Set true for a FREE (0 Sats) live readiness & input validation check before paying.

gt.description: GeeTest v3 gt key (or use captchaId for GeeTest v4).

lang.description: Language code (e.g. "en", "es") for audio_captcha or OCR.

pagedata.description: Optional chlPageData parameter for Cloudflare Turnstile.

proxy.description: Proxy string host:port:user:pass when required by DataDome.

surl.description: Optional surl parameter for Arkose Labs FunCaptcha.

userAgent.description: Browser User-Agent matching session (required for DataDome).

websiteKey.description: Sitekey / websiteKey (for Turnstile, reCAPTCHA v2/v3/Enterprise, hCaptcha, FunCaptcha, AWS WAF).

websiteURL.description: Full URL of the target page containing the CAPTCHA.
